text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Year had finally arrived, marking
K.S. Miracle's transition into the Classic Year—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'll be over here making a call, okay?

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Dad and the others went to the concession stand, so take your time catching up.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please give my regards to your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...All right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, hello? Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes,
Happy New Year.
choice_data_list: Are you getting plenty of rest?
Are you getting plenty of rest?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Mom and the others even booked an inn for us...
We were able to have a really relaxing New Year's.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Since I've made my debut, I thought I really ought to work hard through the New Year holidays, but...
choice_data_list: Right now, getting proper rest is important too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I got scolded like that
around New Year's too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, since Trainer gave me some time off... I'll make sure to cherish it and spend it well."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, and also...
Regarding New Year's cards—
choice_data_list: (Did I write down compliments for Miracle?)
(Did I write "Let's eat lots of osechi!"?)
(Did I draw a picture of the zodiac animal?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... you wrote so many...
so many wonderful things...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Mom and Dad read it out loud so enthusiastically...
Ah, um, they were really happy about it, though..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um. ...But all of it feels
far too good for someone like me—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... umm.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I'll work harder and harder.
Um... I know I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm ho... Wait, huh? Kei-chan?
...Oh my, she's asleep.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I'm just glad you're able to take it easy.
...Hm?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... I'll do my best!!
...Do my... best... ...

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Loud sleep-talking, as always.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I read it properly.
I'm eating the osechi, you know.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The food at the inn was super extravagant, too.
So... on the flip side, I felt like I had to be careful
not to put on too much weight—
choice_data_list: If anything, go ahead and put on some weight!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, that's no good.
Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... if I look unpresentable when we meet after the break... that would be a bit...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I want to meet them looking respectable, properly.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm ho... Wait, huh? Kei-chan?
...Oh my, she's asleep.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I'm just glad you're able to take it easy.
...Hm?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... No way!!
No more... bananas, please...

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Loud sleep-talking, as always.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, that illustration... heheh.
I really, really love it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be able to look at it anytime...
so I took some photos too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you don't mind,
would it be okay if I showed this to my friends?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, you looked so cute.
It almost felt like a waste to keep you all to myself.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That was so cute... hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm ho... Wait, huh? Kei-chan?
...Oh my, she's asleep.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I'm just glad you're able to take it easy.
...Hm?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Look, look!!
...Look, it's so cute... ...

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Loud sleep-talking, as always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that,
we spent a quiet, relaxing New Year's holiday together—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Once again... Happy New Year, Trainer-san.
I look forward to working with you this year as well.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
I'm ready whenever you are!
choice_data_list: Alright, it's our first training session!
Alright, it's our first training session!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: H-A-P-P-Y N-E-W Y-E-A-R~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Miracle aaaand Miratrainer!
Grats! And more grats! And even moooore graaats~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, Helios! And—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, sorry to barge in on you!
Looking forward to working with you again this year!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We just happened to cross paths by the grounds' entrance.
If you are about to start training—
might I join you for a gust across the turf?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"A joint training session, maybe?
I'd be happy to, but um...
what do you think, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: I was actually about to ask the same of you!
I was actually about to ask the same of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod to a delighted K.S.Miracle and look around at the gathered group once more.
...In truth, I couldn't have asked for anything better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though currently resting due to health issues, Yamanin Zephyr is an Umamusume from the same generation who runs the same route as K.S. Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're bound to clash in the future anyway,
there's no way we shouldn't take this chance to race
against someone whose true strength remains unknown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios is a senior Umamusume who debuted the
year before last. She runs on sprint courses as well,
so there's a strong chance she'll become a rival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She placed 5th in last year's Sprinters Stakes,
and her true strength is gradually coming to the fore.
Running alongside her will surely offer much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And above all—Bamboo Memory.
A runner blessed with unmatched, ferocious legs
who has left her mark across countless GⅠ races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For someone like her, who has conquered both the Yasuda Kinen and the Sprinters Stakes, to run alongside K.S.Miracle... It was truly a dream come true...!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on all of you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 'Sup!! Likewise, 'sup!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, should we get started right away?
Everyone's just back from New Year's break, so to prevent injuries,
let's make sure to warm up properly first—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Might I be permitted to join as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby quietly walked up to me.
Seeing her, I couldn't help but be a little surprised.
choice_data_list: (The look on her face is completely different from last year...!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby...! 
Will you run with us too?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe we are the ones in a position to ask. After all... you are all our seniors on this route.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This route... wait.
...I see. Ruby, you're...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
—From here on, I shall take on the sprint division."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With the primary goal set on the Yasuda Kinen,
we shall commence full-scale operations.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wh-Wha-Wha-Whaaaat!?
For real!?!?!?!?
Ruby's switching to sprints!? The Yasuda Kinen!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO HELL YEAHHH---!!
Then I'm taking that spot! I'm running there, toooo---!!
I'm totally hyped, ayy-ayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you really are fiery at heart, Ruby!
Does this mean you came to declare war?
I was planning to enter the Yasuda Kinen too, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It is an undeniable fact that in this category, you possess formidable skill—and are worthy rivals competing for the summit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, with the peerless speed that dwells within
the blood of the 'Illustrious Clan'—
I shall surpass even all of you."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My mind is already made up.
...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sprint division...
is truly turning into a tempest, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Everyone ahead of me looks so dazzling.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, this year for sure—me too.
